notes.title: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence will appear at the BIG Fall Showcase 2025
notes.content: [p]I [b]just 1 day[/b], [i]Ayasa: Shadows of Silence[/i] will appear at the [i]BIG Fall Showcase 2025[/i]![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BQ3rDpbvxIg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This is our passion project, built with love and inspired by the surreal works of Tim Burton, René Laloux, Robert Sahakyants, and Hayao Miyazaki. With no dialogue and a haunting score rooted in Komitas’s music, Ayasa’s story is told entirely through pantomime, visuals, and emotion. It’s a unique adventure where your choices carry real weight leading to endings of either redemption or corruption.[/p][p]The BIG Fall Showcase is the moment where thousands of players will see Ayasa’s world for the first time, and we couldn’t be more excited. If you’ve followed our journey, now is the time to help: add [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146120/Ayasa_Shadows_of_Silence/"]Ayasa[/url] to your Steam wishlist, share the demo, and let others know that a dark tale without words is about to unfold.[/p][p][/p][p]Follow us  [url="https://linktr.ee/_ayagames"]https://linktr.ee/_ayagames[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Discover the new trailer "introducing Ayasa Shadows Of Silence"
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to share the brand-new trailer for [i]Ayasa: Shadows of Silence[/i]! This latest look dives deeper into the eerie and emotional world we’ve been crafting  a surreal journey through six corrupted realms: Faith, Hope, Love, Greed, Indifference, and Betrayal.[/p][previewyoutube="vVuhmC43ayM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In the latest trailer, viewers witness Ayasa's journey as she harnesses the power of light and shadow to overcome obstacles and restore balance to a world teetering on the edge of darkness. The game's unique art direction draws inspiration from renowned artists like Tim Burton and René Laloux, creating a surreal noir fantasy experience. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303390/Ayasa_Shadows_of_Silence_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]In the meantime, players can experience the game's dark atmosphere firsthand by downloading the free demo available now on Steam.[/p]

notes.title: Ayasa Shadow of Silence is a new platformer set in an Elden Ring style world
notes.content:
There's something so enticing about The Lands Between. As someone who isn't a soulslike person, I found myself wrapped up in the Shadow of the Erdtree hype, and finally took FromSoftware's magnum opus out for a spin myself. I immediately feel in love with its twisted, medieval art style, and while the soulslike combat still isn't really my thing, I spent hours exploring its sprawling universe, fighting those absolutely horrific Fingercreepeers and hating every minute of it. Ayasa: Shadows of Silence's world feels somewhat similar, blending a mix of traditional fantasy vistas with eerie, Little Nightmares-style themes. For me, it was an immediate wishlist based purely on its aesthetic alone.

Read the rest of the story...
